level1OfficeBobby.note: Second GPT pass with the paper stack drawn in (PROMPTS-gpt-20261002b.md), processed by scripts/process-level1-bobby-gpt-art.py: rows 0 stamp (M/T), 1 hard slam (O/H), 2 idle, 3 miss; same on-screen size as the old 256 px sheet. deskLine 325/512 puts his body's foot on the scene desk's edge line; he is drawn over the desk with his own paper, so the game's separate paper stack is not drawn. paperFaces: per frame, the centre (x, y) and width of his paper's top sheet as fractions of the cell; paperMarks (the game paper sheet's marks only - 1 one stamp, 2 four, 3 the miss smear; face = its blank stack's top-sheet centre and width) is drawn onto that sheet, and only where paperMask (his paper as it shows in each frame) is - with the miss smear burst - so ink never lands on his hands or face.

level1OfficeGangan.note: Regenerated with GPT from the user's prompts (PROMPTS-20261001.md), processed by scripts/process-level1-gangan-art.py: rows 0 idle, 1 approve, 2 laugh (points left at Dr. Beauty), 3 pressure; feet on the cell's bottom. displayWidth/Height are the old square size callers still pass; drawLevel1OfficeGangan sizes him by idleHeight so he stands where he stood.

level3MassageSofa.note: Top-down sofa (scripts/process-level3-massage-art.py). pillow = the pillow's centre as a fraction of the image; zoom = how much larger than cover-fit it is drawn, so the pillow is wider than her head.

level3MassageFaces.note: 祖賢 face-up, 4x2 expressions, every face set at the same place in its cell. crown/temples are fractions of a cell (measured off the neutral face). bustBottom = where the cell's bottom edge (her shoulders) sits in the scene.

level3MassageHand.note: Bobby's bare right hand from the top edge, 4x2 (cells 448x672: extra forearm on top); mirrored for the other side. thumbs: "in" puts the thumbs toward each other (2026-10-01: both of the user's complaints were about thumbs-out poses); "out" to the outside. Top row temple circles, bottom row scalp knead. tips = each frame's fingertips as a fraction of a cell (measured by the processor). lean = how far each forearm tilts out towards its top corner (radians; less over the crown). crownSpread = how far each hand sits from the middle of her crown (fraction of the face cell). leftThumbFrames = frames the sheet drew with the thumb on the LEFT (the knead row), mirrored the other way so the thumbs never swap sides.

level4ArcadeRoom.note: Bonita's bedroom with the CRT (scripts/process-level4-arcade-art.py). screen = the CRT's glass as fractions of the image (measured by the processor); zoom = how much larger than cover-fit the room is drawn, so the TV fills the middle of the shot; screenTop = where the glass's top edge sits in the scene.

level4ArcadeArena.note: The fighting game's stage (night market), drawn inside the CRT. groundY = where the fighters' feet stand, as a fraction of the screen's height.

level4ArcadePlayers.note: Dr. Beauty (unchanged top row) and Bonita (GPT-redrawn bottom row) seated with controllers: idle, mashing, cheering, upset. Bonita faces screen-left toward the TV in a rear three-quarter view. Torso centers and seated bottoms are registered across poses. place = each one's seat: x from the middle of the scene, bottom = where the cell's bottom sits (below the HUD seam, so they are seen waist up). bobbyHeight = Dr. Beauty's cell drawn this tall; bonitaScale = Bonita against him.

level4BobbyFighter.note: Dr. Beauty's fighter in his champion fit, facing right. Body on the cell's centre line, feet on its bottom.

level4BonitaFighter.note: Bonita's fighter in her bunny onesie, mirrored to face left. scale = her size against Dr. Beauty's fighter (she is the kid).

level5RiverBg.note: GPT skyline preserved in full above the water band, with the complete near embankment and grassy standing surface restored in the foreground.
